chunks: What al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two عليهما السلام, that he was asked about a man who enters the mosque and fears that he will miss the rakʿah, so he said:
He bows before reaching the people, and walks while he is bowing until he reaches them.

key_terms.رَاكِعٌ: being in the state of rukuʿ

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he enters the mosque and fears missing the rukuʿ of the congregational prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one who enters the mosque and fears missing the rakʿah in congregational salat. It states that he may go into rukuʿ before reaching the row and continue moving while in the state of bowing until he joins them.
